title: Door Sensor Night Access Summary
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=zigbee2mqtt:device sensor_type=contact state=open
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| where hour>=23 OR hour<5
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as opens by sensor _time
| where opens>0
| sort - _time
description: Lists door and window opens during the overnight hours, useful both for security awareness and for catching the family member who keeps letting heat out.
value: A simple after-hours contact log gives you just enough household audit trail without turning the whole house into a surveillance system.
implementation: Forward contact-sensor state changes; review the overnight summary each morning or alert on selected sensors immediately.
visualization: Daily table of overnight contact openings by sensor.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which doors or windows got opened late at night while most people should have been asleep.
